filesystem.allocations: process-local System Rust allocator deltas; includes observers/background and excludes foreign C allocators; instrumented builds affect throughput, and filesystem omits object-store observer frames; allocations and reallocations are separate counters; live bytes are endpoint gauges; per-cycle quotients do not isolate metadata or allocation-free paths
filesystem.cache: distributed RAM/disk/peer cache and generic object-store adapter absent; kernel filesystem caching is present but not isolated or measured
filesystem.comparison: one sequential local pair at the same source/binary/geometry; HTTP/Docker VM traversal/RustFS processing/adapter cache change together; cache evolution/background state/observer work differ; no confidence interval or isolated RustFS attribution
filesystem.counters: before_active to after_active process-local observations; boundary observers/background included; not a global atomic cut
filesystem.cpu: process CPU divided by its own monotonic observation interval; observers/background included; excludes backend and collector processes
filesystem.http: filesystem blobs have no HTTP/object-store transport; not_configured with null counters rather than measured zeros
filesystem.latency: 32 log2 microsecond buckets; percentile bounds only; final bucket censored; RPC sub-1us values land in bucket1; no complete-cycle latency histogram
filesystem.logical_payload: 4 KiB active read comparisons and read/write preparation; excludes truncation bytes and untimed setup/oracles
filesystem.physical_io: no new RustFS container/cgroup; no qualified host physical device or TiKV physical IOPS; own-process OS accounting is separate and cannot establish physical IOPS
filesystem.pool: pool checkout await includes possible lazy connection/session setup; queue-only wait unavailable
filesystem.production: local loopback depth-one native clients; 10 Drives is not 10000-client production, OS mounting or cross-host/OIDC qualification
filesystem.quic: worker active-boundary UDP payload counters exclude headers; client retained boundary also includes idle liveness; frames/datagrams/API calls differ
filesystem.rss: nullable endpoints and process lifetime peaks; no per-cell or simultaneous fleet peak; live Rust bytes remain endpoint gauges
filesystem.sql: classified client submissions; successful known-count SELECT returned rows only; no affected/scanned rows, server execution or TiKV attribution
filesystem.throughput: all active clients together; complete cycles and acknowledged RPCs divided by drained active workload duration; open/close included in RPCs

rustfs.allocations: process-local System Rust allocator deltas; includes observers/background and excludes foreign C allocators; both builds instrumented, which affects throughput; allocations and reallocations are separate counters; live bytes are endpoint gauges; per-cycle quotients do not isolate metadata or allocate-free fast paths
rustfs.cache: distributed RAM/disk/peer cache absent; generic object-store adapter cache occupancy separately observed across all adapters; gauges retained; unknown occupancy stays incomplete
rustfs.comparison: fresh parent/current source pair at fixed D10/F1000 geometry with allocation profiling enabled for both; sequential run order, duration-dependent request counts, cache evolution and background state remain confounders; one pair has no confidence intervals or isolated causal throughput estimate
rustfs.counters: before_active to after_active process-local observations; boundary observers/background included; not a global atomic cut
rustfs.cpu: process CPU divided by its own monotonic observation interval; observers/background included; excludes backend and collector processes
rustfs.http: partial observed RustFS service dispatch/body work by mixed data/probe role and method; offered bytes are not uploads/commits; body bytes precede validation/retries; header success is not EOF/durability; durations overlap
rustfs.latency: 32 log2 microsecond buckets; percentile bounds only; final bucket censored; RPC sub-1us values land in bucket1; no complete-cycle latency histogram
rustfs.logical_payload: 4 KiB active read comparisons and read/write preparation; excludes truncation bytes and untimed setup/oracles
rustfs.physical_io: RustFS guest cgroup whole-run accounting includes setup/oracles/background/writeback; no contemporaneous TiKV or host physical flash IOPS
rustfs.pool: pool checkout await includes possible lazy connection/session setup; queue-only wait unavailable
rustfs.production: local loopback depth-one native clients; 10 Drives is not 10000-client production, OS mounting or cross-host/OIDC qualification
rustfs.quic: worker active-boundary UDP payload counters exclude headers; client retained boundary also includes idle liveness; frames/datagrams/API calls differ
rustfs.rss: nullable endpoints and process lifetime peaks; no per-cell or simultaneous fleet peak; live Rust bytes remain endpoint gauges
rustfs.sql: classified client submissions; successful known-count SELECT returned rows only; no affected/scanned rows, server execution or TiKV attribution
rustfs.throughput: all active clients together; complete cycles and acknowledged RPCs divided by drained active workload duration; open/close included in RPCs
